_readme: SPECIAL buffs do NOT add perk card points - they only give the SPECIAL's own effects (AVIF descriptions, Oct 2026):
STR carry weight + melee damage | PER VATS accuracy | END total Health, sprint AP drain, disease resistance
CHA perk sharing, group quest rewards, barter (+ Inspirational XP) | INT hacking, crafted condition, XP gained, scrap
AGI VATS AP + sneak | LCK crit recharge rate, loot condition. So a SPECIAL is only weighted where that effect helps.
HAND-KEPT rules for the Recommended Food Buff Calculator (/bnb/buffs/food/recommended-food-buff-calculator/).
build_food_buff_calculator_json.py validates this file and copies it into dist/calculators/food_buff_calculator.json.
Everything about the ITEMS (which buff, how big, how long, meat/veg, what stacks) comes from the game exports.
Everything about WHY an item gets recommended lives here. To change a recommendation, change a weight here - not the page script.
weights: 0 = never recommend that buff, 1 = core for the build. A buff only shows if its final weight is >= show_threshold.
Final weight for a buff = build weight, then each answer's 'add' is added and each 'mult' is multiplied (adds first, then mults).
'avoid' slots are hard-excluded: no item that GRANTS that buff is recommended at all (e.g. DR for berserkers).
'prefer' (build option): { type: [item names] } - that item takes the slot first whenever it is allowed (menu / avoid rules still apply).
Used for Bows & Throwing: no drink adds bow or throwing damage, so the drink slot goes to Wine (+15 AP) - Kat, 20 Oct 2026.
Nukashine has no alcohol dispel keyword, so it stacks with Wine: both can be taken (the card says so).
Any ALCH item can be recommended; items Buffs n Brew doesn't sell get a 'Not sold at BnB' mark and are left out of the copied order list.
ref = what counts as one 'full strength' buff of that type; only used to rank different buffs against each other.
_goals_readme: GOALS (20 Oct 2026): what a stat is worth comes from dist/specials_stats.json -> goals (built from the game files), e.g. 1 Endurance = 5 HP, 1 Strength = 5 lb, 1 Agility = 10 AP, 1 Intelligence = 3% XP, Heal Rate = % of max HP per sec (out of combat).

An answer (or build) can list 'goals': { goal: weight }. Each slot in that goal gets weight x (its conversion x its slot ref) / refs[goal] - so a +3 END food (15 HP) is weighed against a +40 Max Health food in the same HP.
refs = how big one 'full-strength' buff is in the goal's own unit. Weight 0 = no weighting, just show the reason on the cards (e.g. VATS: '+2 Perception (+0.8 % hit chance)').
'fallback_add' = hand-set weights used only if specials_stats.json can't load on the page (answers AND builds).

Melee build = melee goal (1 STR = 5% melee damage, fAVDMeleeDamageMult). Unarmed build = unarmed goal (1 STR = 10% unarmed damage, fDamageStrengthMult; Unarmed AND Melee Damage buffs both count) - Kat, 20 Oct 2026.
_exclude_items_readme: Item names never recommended (quest-only / can't normally get). Nuclear Don's Custom Chem Blend = W05_MQR_203P Wastelanders main quest chem (+100% dmg, +100 DR, +100 HP) - Claude 20 Oct 2026, ask Kat before adding more.
_display_order_readme: Order the result cards and the stat list are shown in: SPECIAL first, then AP Regen, XP and the rest. Reorder freely.
_base_weights_readme: Kat 28 Oct: every build wants Move Speed (0.4) and Fire Resistance (0.4, Power Armour included), Rad Resistance (0.4; not Power Armour or Ghouls) and Disease Resistance (0.4). Weights every build gets (20 Oct 2026, Kat: bubblegum for hunger & thirst).
_ignore_slots_readme: Kat 28 Oct: never recommended. No cryo enemies in the game; poison resistance is not worth a slot.
_when_readme: Magazine / bobblehead buffs whose game text names a condition (fx.w): team = only with 'In a team', sneak = only for sneaky players, night / alcohol = counted at when_share, swim = never counted (still shown).
_mirror_readme: Weapon-type crit damage (magazines) is only worth what crit damage is worth to this build: final weight = its own weight (how well it fits the weapon, 0-1) x the build's crit_dmg weight. So VATS builds value them, free aim halves them like crit_dmg.

avoid_scorched.fmt: {v}% Chance to Avoid Damage from Scorched

_playstyle_readme: Buffs guide pages (25 Oct 2026, Kat): Combat & events = combat and events; Exploring & looting = looting and exploring. Exploring counts utility buffs in full (full_utility switches off damage_first) and values caps stashes, lockpicking, hacking, carry weight and sneak.

exploring.label: Exploring & looting
exploring.note: Exploring: Perception, Charisma, Intelligence, Agility and Luck all help you loot, sell and get around.

damage_type.label: What damage does your weapon do?

vats.label: VATS
vats.note: V.A.T.S. builds live on crits, so Critical Damage comes first.

weapon.label: Main weapon (optional)
weapon.help: Some magazines only boost one weapon type. Picking one puts its magazine first and drops boosts for other damage types.

melee_vats.label: Do you use V.A.T.S. with your melee / unarmed weapon?

yes.label: Yes (e.g. Hack and Slash)
yes.note: Melee V.A.T.S.: every swing costs AP, so AP, AP regen, accuracy, Luck and crit damage are picked.

power.label: Power Armour
power.note: Power Armour: low carry weight, so Strength and carry weight. It already covers DR, ER and rads.

body.label: Body armour
body.note: Not in Power Armour: Endurance, Max Health and Health Regen.

none.label: Berserker's (no armour)
none.note: Berserker's: no DR buffs (they lower your damage). Endurance, Max Health and Health Regen instead.

bloodied.label: Bloodied (low health)
bloodied.note: Bloodied: take your rads first, then Rad Resistance so more rads don't kill you.

ghoul.label: Ghoul
ghoul.note: Ghouls: no rad, disease or Charisma buffs needed.

carry.label: Do you struggle with carry weight?

yes.label: Yes
yes.note: Die a lot: more health and health regen.

yes.label: Yes
yes.note: XP: XP buffs, Intelligence, and Charisma in a team.

enemy.label: Fighting anything in particular?
enemy.help: For events and farming runs: some magazines only work on one enemy type. Picking one puts those magazines first.

_linked_readme: Kat 28 Oct: when a stat is on their list, the linked stat comes with it. AP follows Agility (Agility IS Action Points, 10 a point), and AP Regen follows Agility and / or AP. Weight = the highest of the from stats x share, unless the stat is already higher. Applied in order, so ap_regen sees the linked AP.
_carry_plan_readme: Kat 28 Oct 2026. When they need carry weight (carry = yes, or Power Armour): prefer = the magazine slot goes to Grognak the Barbarian 9 (+carry weight), the bobblehead slot to Strength, and the alcohol slot to Vintage Mire Magic Moonshine (+4 STR, 4 min); Rad Ant Lager (+50 lb but only 2 min, then a hangover) shows as its alternative because the two cancel each other. always_add = items with no dispel group that stack with everything: added on top, never taking a food slot. cover = a carry weight food AND a Strength food are both picked (different food groups, they stack).
_slot_why_readme: Kat 28 Oct: one plain sentence per stat, shown under the stat name in the Stats view (why we recommend it), with a Learn more link to its SPECIALs & Stats guide. Words only - no numbers or formulas.

str.t: Strength raises your melee damage and how much you can carry.

per.t: Perception helps your V.A.T.S. shots land and widens your compass so you spot more.

end.t: Endurance gives you a bigger health bar, so you can take more hits.

cha.t: Charisma gets you better prices when you trade, and more XP when you're in a team.

int.t: Intelligence earns you more XP and more components when you scrap junk.

agi.t: Agility gives you more Action Points and helps you sneak.

luck.t: Luck fills your V.A.T.S. critical meter faster and means the weapons and armour you loot are in better condition.

ap.t: More Action Points for V.A.T.S., sprinting, jumping and jetpacks.

xp.t: You earn more XP from everything you do.

carry.t: You can carry more before you're over-encumbered.

dmg_melee.t: More damage with melee weapons and fists.

dmg_unarmed.t: More damage with fists and unarmed weapons.

dmg_melee_weapons.t: More damage with melee weapons (not fists).

dmg_unscoped.t: More damage with weapons that have no scope.

dmg_alien.t: More damage with the Alien Blaster.

dmg_fistknife.t: More damage with fists and knives.

crit_dmg.t: Your V.A.T.S. critical hits hit harder.

crit_ballistic.t: Your V.A.T.S. critical hits with bullet weapons hit harder.

crit_energy.t: Your V.A.T.S. critical hits with energy weapons hit harder.

crit_heavy.t: Your V.A.T.S. critical hits with heavy guns hit harder.

crit_melee.t: Your V.A.T.S. critical hits with melee and fists hit harder.

sneak_attack.t: Your attacks from sneak do more damage.

sneak.t: Enemies have a harder time spotting you.

invis.t: Turns you invisible for a short time.

vats_acc.t: Your V.A.T.S. shots and melee swings land more often.

gun_acc.t: Steadier aim when you shoot without V.A.T.S.

max_hp.t: A bigger health bar, so you can take more hits.

heal_rate.t: Heals you back up over time when you're out of a fight.

dr.t: You take less damage from bullets, melee and other physical hits.

er.t: You take less damage from lasers, plasma and other energy weapons.

fire_res.t: You take less damage from fire, like flamers and Molotovs.

rad_res.t: You pick up fewer rads from the world around you.

disease_res.t: Less chance of catching a disease.

ap_refill.t: Gives you some Action Points back straight away.

hunger_thirst.t: Your hunger and thirst go down slower, so you eat and drink less.

pa_drain.t: Your Power Armour uses less fusion core power.

heavy_ammo.t: Your heavy weapons use less ammo.

_team_play_readme: Weights added by the Solo / In a team page option (not a question). Kat 27 Oct: Charisma is wanted in a team (Inspirational: Charisma-keyed XP for you and an XP aura for teammates, only in a team), when XP is important, or when exploring & looting (barter). Solo + XP not important + combat = no Charisma.

team.note: In a team: Charisma means more XP for you and your team.

_damage_first_readme: Chems and alcohol only get ONE slot each (dispel groups), so that slot goes to DAMAGE OUTPUT: buffs in the 'Damage' slot group count in full, everything else counts at non_damage_share. Carry Weight also counts in full when they say they struggle with carry weight (that is the only time Rad Ant Lager wins). full_when (Kat 27 Oct): the listed slots also count in full when question q has answer a. Strength counts in full for Melee / Unarmed (it IS their damage), and Strength + carry weight count in full in Power Armour (carry weight is low in PA) and when they struggle with carry weight.
